integrity: General proof is analytical. Eight exact finite-field calculations and numerical Gram checks are corroboration, not exhaustive certification or independent scientific review.
scientific_limitations: Two-dimensional odd-characteristic finite fields; codimension-one mean-zero Parseval frames, not bases of the full space; no characteristic-two or unrestricted universality assertion. Classical spectral-pair-to-frame transfer is prior work. Full-text coverage of one related 2021 paper remains unchecked.
title: Anisotropic norm-torus wavelet frames over every odd finite field
